name: An Amaranthine Tryst
source:
Follow the story of Haylie, as she struggles with her own inner demons to find what's missing in what appears to be a perfectly desirable lifestyle. 

This game features a more event-driven format than most vanilla visual novels. You the player may move freely to different locations, and experience the story as you explore the in-game world. Also, you'll have a phone you can use to call someone after you get their number, opening up more possible dialogue! There's no guarantee they'll answer, but sometimes it can be helpful to phone a friend.

[From [url=https://narwhalogical.itch.io/an-amaranthine-tryst-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随海莉的故事，看她如何与内心的恶魔抗争，在看似完美而令人称羡的生活中寻找缺失的东西。

本作采用比大多数传统视觉小说更注重事件驱动的形式。你可以自由前往不同地点，在探索游戏世界的过程中经历故事。你还会得到一部手机，拿到某人的号码后就能打电话给对方，从而开启更多对话！当然，对方不一定会接听，但有时给朋友打个电话也许会有帮助。

[来源：[url=https://narwhalogical.itch.io/an-amaranthine-tryst-demo]itch.io[/url]]
